description: Quantizes or retunes a 1V/octave pitch to the tuning table held by an MTS-ESP master running elsewhere on the computer

params.text: Chooses which way a pitch falling between two tuned pitches is rounded: down, to the nearer of the two, or up
Chooses how the tuning is applied: quant moves the input to the nearest tuned pitch, retune rounds the input to a twelve-tone note and plays that note's tuned pitch

inputs.text: The pitch to be quantized, at 1V per octave

outputs.text: The quantized pitch at 1V per octave; with no MTS-ESP master connected the input is passed through untouched
A 10V pulse 1ms long on a channel whenever that channel's output pitch changes

notes: with no MTS-ESP master running anywhere on the computer this module quantizes nothing and passes its input straight through, and the trigger output is never written
a master has to be loaded elsewhere: in a VCV Host module in this patch, or in any application on the same computer, since MTS-ESP passes tunings between processes
the lamp is fully lit while a master is found and dim while none is
the output is worked out again at most every 5ms and holds its last value between those
notes the master has marked as filtered out are skipped in quant mode, so the output never lands on them

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic
